title: Lil Hazy releases his recent track “T00 F@ST”
htmlContent:
American-based music star Lil Hazy is a multi-talented rapper, singer, and lyrical genius who has climbed the steepest steps to get to where he is today. The 18 years old rapper has taken time to learn all he needs to know about his craft after growing up in a musical household. The talented star shows his raw talents in his recent “T00 F@ST” track.

In the release of his recent track “T00 F@ST,” Lil Hazy reflects on his past, present, and future through heavily processed vocals, infectious flows, and bass-bumping musical production. The vocal performance drives the point of the song home, and the writing is poetic in its approach to making a record that you will love.
